main_text.l: cunque iurauerint, ab eiusmodi iu-rameto & fidelitatis & obsequij de-bito absoluimus & liberamus: & in-terdicimus ne illis audeant obedire,
Monemus & hortamur Fran-corum Regem Christianissimum ut ad executionem nostræ sententiæ incumbat. Datum Romæ, 5. Id. Sept. anno 1585.
Domine, maledicent illi & tu benedices: qui insurgent in me confundentur,seruus autem tuus lætabitur.

page.notes: "rameto" is printed with a mark over the vowel that I read as a suspension of the m; the reading "rameto" is not fully certain. "Romæ, 5. Id." : the numeral after the comma is hard to read, so I read it as 5 with some doubt. "Pag. ead." is a small reference line set centred between the two paragraphs; I have given it as a foot paragraph. The psalm verse is copied as printed, including "confundentur,seruus" without a space.
